textContent_en:
<size=30><color=#ffd966>This is a system message.</color></size>

 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>It is using standard html elements.</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>It is customizable in api/config/notice.json</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>type = 0/1 (image in filename, text in textContent)， category = 0/1 (update, system), state = 0/1 (hide, show), actionType = 0/1 (use hyperlink), filename = image file name.</color></size>
textContent_jp:
<size=30><color=#ffd966>これはシステムメッセージです。</color></size>

 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>標準のHTML要素を使用しています。</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>api/config/notice.jsonでカスタマイズ可能です。</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>type = 0/1 (filename内の画像, textContent内のテキスト), category = 0/1 (update、system)、state = 0/1 (hide、show)、actionType = 0/1 (use hyperlink)、filename = 画像ファイル名。</color></size>
textContent_ko:
<size=30><color=#ffd966>이것은 시스템 메시지입니다.</color></size>

 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>표준 HTML 요소를 사용합니다.</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>api/config/notice.json에서 사용자 정의할 수 있습니다.</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>type = 0/1 (filename의 이미지, textContent의 텍스트), category = 0/1 (업데이트, 시스템), state = 0/1 (숨기기, 표시), actionType = 0/1 (하이퍼링크 사용), filename = 이미지 파일 이름.</color></size>
textContent_zh-chs:
<size=30><color=#ffd966>这是一则系统资讯。 </color></size>

 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>此内容使用了标准HTML。 </color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>可以在 api/config/notice.json 修改。</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>type = 0/1 (filename里的图片, textContent里的文字), category = 0/1 (更新, 系统), state = 0/1 (隐藏, 显示), actionType = 0/1 (是否使用超连结), filename = 图片档案名称.</color></size>
textContent_zh-cht:
<size=30><color=#ffd966>這是一則系統資訊。</color></size>

 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>此內容使用了標準HTML。</color></size>
 <size=22><color=#bbb9c7>可以在 api/config/notice.json 修改。</color></size>
<size=22><color=#bbb9c7>type = 0/1 (filename裡的圖片, textContent裡的文字), category = 0/1 (更新, 系統), state = 0/1 (隱藏, 顯示), actionType = 0/1 (是否使用超連結), filename = 圖片檔案名稱.</color></size>
